name: downrange
description: A band, pane, and /downrange table: progress, ETA, and last output for Claude Code background shells and Monitor watches, tool activity for subagents, state for workflows, and the next /loop wakeup.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Show a one-line status band above the prompt while background work runs.

answerStatusPrompts.title: Answer status prompts locally
answerStatusPrompts.description: When Claude is idle and background work runs, answer an exact status prompt such as "status?" with the /downrange table instead of sending it to Claude. Send the same prompt again within 60 seconds to ask Claude.
